description: OpenAPI yaml must carry every field of with_replacement-replaced types: fabro-types::Conclusion gained exit_kind (fabro-b907) but the yaml Conclusion schema did not, so every fabro-api-client regen silently dropped it; the Rust parity test then codified the drift instead of failing it. Fixed by adding exit_kind to docs/public/api-reference/fabro-api.yaml + regenerating (fabro-67e5). Rule: when a Rust type bound via build.rs with_replacement changes serde shape, update the yaml schema in the same change and re-run bun run generate; a dropping regen is a spec bug, not accepted churn.
resolution: exit_kind added to yaml Conclusion schema; TS client regen restored the field; run_failure_round_trip pins it
